videos.title: Microsoft Surface Pro 2026 UNBOXING - Snapdragon X2 Elite
videos.description:
This is how Microsoft’s new Surface Pro powered by @snapdragon X2 Elite chip handled the launch of the new Kit in London 🇬🇧 
 
With 39% more Single core performance, and 50% better GPU performance than the previous generation, the Surface Pro just got better with 20 hours of video playback. 
 
Handled all the daily edits, in this thin premium form factor from Microsoft. Big shoutouts to legends Berbatov and Wes Brown - chatted football, a bit of tech and signed the new kits 🔥
